wiki_title.description: Human-readable wiki name shown in the browser title bar and site header

wiki_lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the DokuWiki UI (e.g. en, de, fr, es, it)

wiki_license.description: Content license key displayed in the page footer (cc-by-sa, cc-by, cc-by-nc-sa, publicdomain, or empty to suppress the footer notice)

wiki_baseurl.description: Canonical base URL of the wiki (e.g. https://wiki.example.com); leave empty to detect automatically from HTTP request headers

savedir.description: Absolute filesystem path to the DokuWiki data directory; must be writable by the web-server user and outside the document root

wiki_start.description: Page ID used as the wiki home page; DokuWiki shows a create-page prompt if this page does not exist

wiki_template.description: Active theme name; the matching directory must exist under lib/tpl/ (e.g. dokuwiki, vector, bootstrap3)

wiki_tagline.description: Short subtitle shown below the wiki name in the header area; leave empty to hide the tagline entirely

wiki_sidebar.description: Page ID rendered as the persistent sidebar next to content; leave empty to disable the sidebar

max_section_depth.description: Maximum heading level (1-5) included in auto-generated tables of contents; headings deeper than this are omitted

use_heading.description: Whether to use a page's first heading as its display title in listings: 0=disabled, 1=navigation links only, 2=everywhere including breadcrumbs and search results

sneaky_index.description: Hide the sitemap and index from unauthenticated visitors; recommended true whenever the wiki requires a login to browse

hidden_pages.description: PCRE regex matched against page IDs; matching pages are excluded from search results, the index, and recent changes; leave empty to show all pages

use_acl.description: Enable the ACL access-control system; should be true for any wiki reachable outside a fully trusted private network

superuser.description: Login name or @group granted full superuser rights; can manage users, ACL, and all configuration

manager.description: Login name or @group granted manager rights; can manage users and wiki pages but not global configuration

open_register.description: Allow anyone to self-register an account without admin involvement; set to false for intranet or invite-only wikis

email_confirm.description: Send a confirmation email that must be clicked before a self-registered account is activated; requires a working mail setup

disabled_actions.description: DokuWiki action names to disable site-wide; each entry suppresses the corresponding feature for all users

items.description: Action name to disable (e.g. register, login, search, revisions, recent, diff, edit, source, backlink)

cache_time.description: Seconds a rendered page is kept in the cache before being regenerated on the next request; -1=cache forever, 0=disable caching

lock_time.description: Seconds an edit lock is held on a page after the editor opens it, preventing simultaneous conflicting edits

recent_count.description: Number of changes displayed on the Recent Changes page and in the RSS/Atom feed

max_file_size.description: Maximum permitted upload size in bytes (2097152=2 MiB, 10485760=10 MiB); set to 0 to disable file uploads entirely

jpg_quality.description: JPEG compression quality for automatically resized images (0-100); higher values produce sharper images at the cost of larger file sizes

im_convert.description: Absolute path to the ImageMagick convert binary (e.g. /usr/bin/convert); leave empty to use the GD PHP extension instead

mail_from.description: Envelope-from address used in all outgoing emails (notifications, registration confirmations, password resets)

smtp_host.description: SMTP relay server hostname (e.g. smtp.example.com); leave empty to use PHP built-in mail()

smtp_port.description: TCP port for the SMTP relay: 25 (plain/opportunistic), 465 (implicit TLS), or 587 (STARTTLS)

smtp_user.description: SMTP authentication username; leave empty for an unauthenticated (open) relay

smtp_pass.description: SMTP authentication password; inject from a secrets manager at deploy time rather than storing in version control

smtp_secure.description: SMTP connection encryption: empty string=none (port 25), ssl=implicit TLS (port 465), tls=STARTTLS (port 587)

extra_conf.description: Additional $conf directives not covered by this template; each entry is emitted as a commented PHP assignment at the end of the file

value.description: Configuration value; rendered as a PHP single-quoted string literal

description.description: One-line comment placed above the generated directive explaining its purpose to the operator
